pairs.description: Co-administration of black cohosh with HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors like atorvastatin may increase the risk of elevated transaminases and hepatotoxicity.
pairs.mechanism: Additive hepatic metabolic stress and potential CYP3A4 pathway modulation by triterpene glycosides.

pairs.description: Black cohosh may modulate estrogen receptor binding, raising clinical concerns regarding interference with tamoxifen in breast cancer management.
pairs.mechanism: Selective estrogen receptor modulatory (SERM-like) activity by actein and related triterpenoids.

pairs.description: Preclinical data indicates black cohosh extracts can attenuate the cytotoxic effectiveness of platinum-based antineoplastics like cisplatin.
pairs.mechanism: Induction of intracellular protective antioxidants and interference with platinum-DNA adduct apoptosis.
